approvedChangeOrdersCount.description: Count of non-deleted approved Fieldwire Prime Change Orders for this project. Included in list responses.

approvedChangeOrdersTotal.description: Sum of non-deleted approved Fieldwire Prime Change Order total costs for this project. Included in list responses.

revisedContractValue.description: Original project contractValue plus approvedChangeOrdersTotal. Included in list responses.

totalPOCommitted.description: Sum of non-cancelled purchase order totals for this project. Included in list responses.

activePOsCount.description: Count of non-cancelled purchase orders for this project. Included in list responses.

budgetLimit.description: Revised contract value multiplied by targetBudgetPercent. Included in list responses.

budgetRemaining.description: budgetLimit minus totalPOCommitted. Included in list responses.

spendUtilization.description: Percentage of budgetLimit committed by non-cancelled purchase orders. Included in list responses.
